scope: Source-based admission audit; not a completed publication-performance experiment.

sources.location: Section VII, Table IV, Figures 9-12, appendix
sources.version: 17-page camera-ready; do not substitute the earlier arXiv version

sources.note: Remote HEAD is a lookup identity, not the revision of our local port.

sources.local_copy: Non-Git source copy; its current parameters are 1 Little and 1 Big, not 11+3.

grasu_table4.unit: million successfully updated edges per second
grasu_table4.platform: U250, 200 MHz, four DDR4 channels, URAM hot storage, 32 update PEs, 8-word segments
grasu_table4.batch_policy: Ten temporal update batches by default; recover original event multiplicity and batching before comparison.

regraph_table4_AM.clock_note: Figure 10 explicitly normalizes to 210 MHz; do not assign that clock to a Table IV row without confirming its scope.

algorithm.evidence: Both execute graph edge updates; operation-level trace semantics remain a workload gate.

workload.evidence: Original temporal AU event multiplicity, base graph, ordering, and ten-batch split have not been reproduced here.

initial_state.evidence: Original PMA reservation, reorder, hot-set selection, and snapshot state need independent reconstruction.

topology.evidence: GraSU Section 6.1 uses 8-word PMA segments; our routed sharded-K4 profile uses 16-word segments. No original-G control model is admitted.

memory.evidence: Paper: URAM hot edges plus U250 DDR4. Current profile: direct_cache_hbm_rmw=true on U55C; prepare_pure_hw_pipeline_build.sh defines GRASU_PURE_PIPELINE_DIRECT_CACHE.

clock.evidence: Paper experiments use 200 MHz; sharded-K4 profile uses 150 MHz. No automatic throughput rescaling is justified.

boundary.evidence: Need isolated G event boundaries and URAM preload/writeback inclusion; setup-inclusive host throughput is not Table 4 kernel-update throughput.

numerator.evidence: Paper counts successfully updated edges; trace events, duplicates, lowered operations, and accepted updates are not interchangeable.

correctness.evidence: No new run on the exact publication-matched temporal trace has passed yet.

algorithm.evidence: Use static full PR, not residual PR; verify fixed-point arithmetic, iteration count, termination, and the traversed-edge denominator from the original artifact.

workload.evidence: Must pin the exact amazon-2008 graph, duplicate/self-loop policy, DBG reorder, partition order, and padding; a compact slice is not the paper graph.

initial_state.evidence: Paper static PR state must be reproduced, not a resident dynamic-update state.

topology.evidence: Table IV uses graph-selected heterogeneous pipelines; current K4 uses four Little frontends and one shared downstream, without a Big path. 11L+3B is an example, not the universal Table IV topology.

memory.evidence: Paper U280 original edge-array ports and buffers differ from current U55C sharded PMA placement; no resource normalization has been validated.

clock.evidence: Current K4 is 150 MHz; confirm Table IV frequency scope independently of Figure 10's 210-MHz statement.

boundary.evidence: Current adapter+R includes PMA occupancy and reader effects; the published R path reads preprocessed compact edges. Neither G nor host time belongs in this isolated comparison.

numerator.evidence: Need traversed edges with the same iteration and graph-direction conventions, not accepted update bytes or useful dynamic edges.

correctness.evidence: No original-topology simulator run on this exact static PR case has been admitted.

algorithm.evidence: ReGraph Section VII-A and README define CC as Closeness Centrality. Our CC is Connected Components. Their Table IV rates cannot calibrate our CC.

workload.evidence: No common-algorithm publication workload has been selected for this intentionally rejected alias.

initial_state.evidence: Different graph problems have different initial states.

topology.evidence: Do not proceed to topology matching before resolving the algorithm mismatch.

memory.evidence: No normalized memory comparison for this rejected alias.

clock.evidence: No normalized clock comparison for this rejected alias.

boundary.evidence: Different algorithms cannot acquire a shared valid window by renaming the label.

numerator.evidence: Traversed-edge conventions need the same algorithm first.

correctness.evidence: Separate oracles do not turn these two algorithms into one comparison.

algorithm.evidence: Predeclare one common original algorithm, preferably full PR, before collecting A4 and B timing.

workload.evidence: A4 compact edges and B PMA must represent identical logical edges, state, and partition order; report padding separately.

initial_state.evidence: Both paths must start from exactly the same vertex properties.

topology.evidence: Original four-Little/zero-Big control is not implemented in this simulator. Parameterizing current K4 is not an independent original-ReGraph control.

memory.evidence: Match ports, outstanding budgets, source buffering and merger/apply resources; PMA occupancy remains an explicit B-path difference.

clock.evidence: Run both resource-matched controls at a common clock; no fitted clock conversion.

boundary.evidence: Measure source/edge fetch through result publication for A4 and B, with G complete before either starts; count reader overlap once.

numerator.evidence: Report common logical edges per sweep plus physical edge/PMA traffic and cycles.

correctness.evidence: Independent per-iteration state and traffic checks are required before any performance-ratio claim.
